declaredIdentity: Tenant + normalized application name or alias (one claim stream per normalized name, same scheme as LocationNameClaim); holder is the exact DeclaredApplication stream in the same tenant.
invariant: One normalized application name or alias is held by at most one active application within a tenant. Claim precedes the application fact that uses the name; release follows retirement or rename. An attributed merge retires the losing application with a merged_into reference and transfers or releases its names to the survivor (M0-D05 rules D05-09, D05-10).

logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation: exact redelivery resolves the original result, a changed admission is a new identity

selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant + normalized application name or alias (one claim stream per normalized name, same scheme as LocationNameClaim); holder is the exact DeclaredApplication stream in the same tenant.

productRules.rule: An application has one canonical name and zero or more aliases, and each normalized alias is unique within the tenant.
Duplicate applications are resolved by an attributed merge that retires one record with a merged_into reference to the survivor.

decides: A tenant holds one canonical name and any number of aliases per application, each normalized and claimed individually; a claim already held by a different active application is refused. Merging retires the losing application with a merged_into reference to the survivor, and its names transfer or release only with that attributed merge.
